written_in: Stage 2, before any new model was fitted

confirmatory.grid_offsets_rule: maximin: each confirmatory grid origin is chosen (1 km grid, greedy) to maximise the minimum wrap-around distance to the three development grid origins and to the other confirmatory origin (label-free)
confirmatory.initial_offsets_replaced: [[0.5, 0.5], [0.25, 0.75]] x block; replaced in Stage 2 before any model evaluation because c2 nearly coincided with development repeat 3 (block ARI 0.77)
confirmatory.balance: rows per fold (greedy, blocks in random order)
confirmatory.redraw_rule: if any fold has < 10 positives or < 10 negatives for any disease, redraw with seed + 1 (logged)

fitness.formula: F = mean_b AUC_b - lambda * SD_b AUC_b - mu * complexity
fitness.complexity: share of the switchable feature groups that are switched on (climate variables, coordinate group, neighbourhood rate types, cross-disease)

inner_cv.unit: outer spatial blocks of the same partition, balanced by rows

surrogate.primary: location-level ExtraTrees regressor, 100 trees (one row per training location, weighted by households)
surrogate.fidelity_rule: Stage 3: Spearman rho between surrogate fitness and full-model fitness over 30 random candidates (1 outer fold per disease). Use primary if rho >= 0.7, else alternative.

config.final_learner: ExtraTrees, 300 trees, row level, with the selected hyperparameters; refit on the full outer training set

budget.stage8_ablations: Stage 6 settings on development repeat 1 (5 folds); variants that need no search are evaluated directly

comparators.a: simple rank average of the model library (run-3 21 models + LightGBM + SVM)
comparators.b: best single model chosen on inner folds (mean inner-block ROC-AUC)

config.ensemble_component: rank-scaled weights shrunk to uniform: w = (1 - alpha) w_SGO + alpha / M, alpha in {0, 0.25, 0.5, 0.75, 1} chosen by repeated inner CV; dropped if not better than comparator (a) on inner validation
config.calibration: Platt scaling on inner out-of-fold predictions (reported; does not change ROC-AUC)
config.threshold_rule: Youden index on inner out-of-fold predictions
config.success_rule: Confirmatory partition only. Pooled location-cluster bootstrap (B = 1000) 95% CI of the ROC-AUC difference SR-SGO minus comparator is above 0 for BOTH comparator (a) and comparator (b), for at least 2 of 3 diseases.
config.secondary_statistics: corrected resampled t-test (Nadeau & Bengio 2003) with Holm correction across comparators; Friedman test with Nemenyi critical difference
config.go_no_go_gate: After Stage 6, on development folds: proceed to Stage 9 only if SR-SGO mean ROC-AUC > comparator (a) AND pooled bootstrap ROC-AUC difference > 0, for at least 2 of 3 diseases. Otherwise stop and report.
config.reporting: Every run, variant, ablation and failure is reported. No method is added after seeing confirmatory results.

confirmatory_partition.status: SEALED - no model may be evaluated on it before Stage 9

deviations.what: confirmatory grid origins changed from fixed fractions to the maximin rule
deviations.why: c2 nearly coincided with development repeat 3 (block ARI 0.77)
deviations.when: before any model evaluation; no labels used except the pre-registered class-count check

deviations.what: search surrogate = row-level ExtraTrees-100 for all diseases (pre-registered rule selected location-level)
deviations.why: location-level fidelity for CBPP was rho = 0.62 (< 0.7) and it misranked the best candidates; row-level rho = 0.96-0.98
deviations.basis: inner-CV diagnostics on training data only (Stage 3); no test results used

clarifications.text: rho is computed per disease (30 candidates each, outer folds r1/f0, r1/f1, r1/f2 for CBPP, FMD, LSD); the location-level surrogate is used if the MEDIAN of the three per-disease Spearman rho values (vs the full ExtraTrees-300 fitness) is >= 0.7, otherwise the row-level surrogate.

stage3_decisions.rule: median per-disease rho >= 0.7 -> location-level, else row-level

additions.what: random search with the same evaluation budget added as a null baseline in the optimiser comparison
additions.why: needed to show whether any metaheuristic beats random sampling of the same number of candidates

assumptions.text: implemented as the MSGO acquiring phase without the self-awareness branch (MSGO modifies only the acquiring phase; Naik, Satapathy & Abraham 2020; equations as given in Meesala, Parida & Naik 2024, Algorithm 2). To be checked against Satapathy & Naik 2016 before the manuscript.
